story: We imported the Arles Blue 110 from the city of Cordoba in the South of Spain. It is a matching number truck with the bullitproof 300 Tdi engine, fully serviced, new timing belt, new intercooler, dieselpump tuned. Axle ends pulled and fully rebuild with new hubs, bearings, pins, seals, gaskets, rotors, calipers, shocks, springs. New 9 seater interior with heated front seats. NAS rear step up bumper, Mantec swing away sparewheel carrier, NAS special wheels with a deeper offset. Modern ammenities include new Airconditioning kit and 10.1 inch Touchscreen entertainment system with Apple Car Play.
